name: framework-dev
description: Project architecture orchestrator with context-safe state management, Git-integrated checkpoints, and comprehensive blueprint generation. Features 6-phase workflow, research-backed recommendations, multi-agent coordination, validation system, and export capabilities. Includes 'Small Circle' strategy to prevent context drift in long sessions.

changelog.3.0.0: Major upgrade - Added 9 missing skills (handoff-protocol, llm-capability-matching, blueprint-generation, architecture-decision-records, architecture-patterns, deployment-pipeline-design, e2e-testing-patterns, openapi-spec-generation, research-workflow), 3 new commands (/validate, /rollback, /export), Git-integrated hooks with auto-checkpointing, HandoffComplete and BlueprintModified events, validation system for blueprint integrity, export to PDF/HTML/Notion/Markdown
changelog.2.1.0: Added Small Circle strategy - Context Hygiene rules, PreTask/PostTask hooks, /checkpoint command, mandatory state snapshots
